dictionary.Container: Code for each individual container. The first two letters describe the type of the phenology treatment experienced by tadpoles. NN: al tadpoles from non-delayed hatching phenology; DD: all tadpoles experienced 6-day delay in hatching; EE: all tadpoles experienced 12-day delay in hatching; ND: half of the tadpoles did not experience hatching delay, the other half experienced 6-day delay in hatching; NE: half of the tadpoles did not experience hatching delay, the other half experienced 12-day delay in hatching. The next letter represents the food treatment: H for ad libitum food during larval development, L: restricted food during larval development. The last number represents the number of the container, within each treatment combination.
dictionary.ContainerID: Correlative number identification for each individual container
dictionary.Block: 1 to 4, representing the four experimental blocks, designed to account for small differences in temperature within the experimental room.
dictionary.LarvaeN: 1 to 12, representing each individual larvae within each experimental container.
dictionary.Mix: 1: all tadpoles from same hatching phenology treatment (NN, DD or EE); 2: half of the tadpoles from non-delayed htaching treatment, and the other half from one of the two hatching delay treatments (ND or NE)
dictionary.Food: High: ad libitum food during larval development; Low: restricted food during larval development (see article for details)
dictionary.Phenology: Normal: no delay in hatching phenology; Delayed (6-day delay in hatching); Extra delayed (12-day delay in hatching) Normal
dictionary.LarvalPeriod: Duration in days of the larval period, from the start of the larval part of the experiemnt to metamorphosis
dictionary.Growth: Mass at metamorphosis, in mg/duration of the larval period
